$comment: MCP servers and the credentials they need. This file is committed to a public repo, so it holds the NAME of an environment variable, never a value. Add a server here and the agent can reach it; nothing else changes.

apify.$toolProfileNote: Which tools this server exposes. See toolProfiles below.

gmail.$note: Placeholder. Email is a channel worth testing against LinkedIn, but it is not wired yet and nothing sends.

toolProfiles.$comment: Apify's MCP endpoint takes a ?tools= parameter, so the size and shape of the tool surface is a variable rather than a fixture. This matters most for small models: a 3B model must reproduce a namespaced tool name exactly and fit a generic call-actor schema in its context. Switching profile is the cheapest way to find out whether a failure is the model or the surface.

narrow.description: Named actors with typed schemas. One call per intent, no store search. Start here for a small model.

discovery.description: The agent searches the Apify store itself and reads an actor's schema before calling it. Maximum freedom, three round trips before anything useful, large generic schema.

all.description: Whatever the server exposes by default.
